campaign_logline: A desperate pilot must navigate corporate debt and territorial squabbles to simply afford fuel for the next jump.
opening_situation: You are broke. Your credits balance is less than a decent meal, and you have one Reaver-class hostile vessel blocking your immediate exit from the local cluster.
main_mystery: Unraveling which major corporate entity—Zenith, Aurelia, or Vanguard—is systematically bleeding localized commerce dry through predatory contract enforcement.
act_1_outline: Secure enough credits by running a low-risk salvage job near Zenith's perimeter.
Intercept minor data packets detailing unusual resource transfers involving Aurelian assets.
Survive an aggressive boarding action orchestrated by a Vanguard enforcer group.
long_term_reveal: The primary conflict is not between the three factions, but rather that one of them is merely hired muscle for a much smaller, more deeply embedded financial consortium operating across all sectors.
tone: Grinding corporate bureaucracy with cheap blaster fire.
core_pressure: Immediate solvency and avoiding asset seizure by local enforcement bodies.

factions.zenith: Zenith enforces exorbitant tariffs on salvaged materials passing through their primary docking zones.
factions.aurelia: Aurelia controls the only reliable jump-gate maintenance contracts, demanding steep performance bonds.
factions.vanguard: Vanguard specializes in 'security' sweeps that invariably look like asset liquidation attempts for minor infractions.

kaelen_rule: Kaelen operates exclusively as a high-end broker of sensitive, off-the-books information and logistical arrangements.
kaelen_angle: She is actively managing the debt ledger for one of the three major powers, using it to keep them all in check against each other.
kaelen_hint_plan: She always carries a data slate whose display flickers with unrecognizable jurisdictional markers.
When discussing tariffs, she uses overly precise legalistic jargon that seems sourced from multiple conflicting codes.
She refuses to look directly at the ship's manifest when confirming payment details.
She frequently asks about local drydock capacity rates for non-combat hulls.
kaelen_hint_style: Overly precise details regarding paperwork and jurisdictional minutiae.
kaelen_never_reveal: Her true relationship with the initial source of your crippling debt.
faction_reveal_rule: New systems reveal a functional faction whose primary commodity or conflict directly intersects with one of Zenith's, Aurelia's, or Vanguard's existing concerns.
humor_rule: Humor should derive from bureaucratic absurdity and material deprivation.
address_rule: "Pilot." or "Freelancer." (Never by name unless explicitly paid for the privilege).
fallback_rule: If a required faction detail is missing, default to stating they are aggressively over-policing an existing resource node.
story_horizon_rule: New horizons introduce entirely new local power players whose immediate need for cash or leverage forces them into contact with one of the established three factions' zones of influence.

story_arcs.name: The Manifest Debt
story_arcs.summary: The player must navigate a network of escalating financial demands to clear enough debt to buy reliable passage out of the local cluster.

rumor_trails.name: The Ghost Ledger
rumor_trails.hint_theme: A specific pattern of unaccounted-for transfer credits or collateral seizures.
clue_templates: A heavily encrypted data chip mentioning a three-party settlement involving non-standard currency units.
Witness reports detailing unmarked vessels collecting 'outstanding service fees' in disputed sectors.
rumor_trails.payoff: The location of the original collateral that was used to structure the entire local debt cycle.

regeneration_triggers.description: When the main story arc concludes, unlock a new, larger economic zone to continue the conflict.

expansion_rules: New sectors introduce entirely different forms of 'tax' or mandatory service payment.
The established three factions will begin actively competing for control over the *next* major choke point encountered.
